notes:
Summary: enterprise support SaaS with heavy focus on ticket deflection and live agent augmentation. Primary ask: scale embeddings index to millions of docs, rerank for top-5 precision, keep p95 end-to-end latency under 300ms (goal 200-250ms) for deflection API. Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; they expect cost per query <$0.02 to be viable at scale.

Background / environment:
- 15 years in market, multi-tenant SaaS platform, 1.2B ticket events lifetime.
- Current search: Elastic + custom heuristics; experimenting with vector search for 18 months.
- Knowledge base: ~3M canonical articles + 12M historical ticket snippets + 1.5M attachments (expected embedding candidates ~16M).
- Peak QPS for support-facing flows: 120 qps; typical steady-state 20-35 qps.

Primary technical requirements (from SE call):
- Retrieval hybrid: BM25 + ANN candidate retrieval -> neural reranker for top-5. Aim to limit neural reranker calls to <= 10 candidates ideally.
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end (retrieve + rerank + response) <= 300ms; P99 under 500ms.
- Reranker quality target: MRR/top-5 precision lift vs baseline >= 18%.
- Indexing cadence: nightly full reindex + nearline incremental updates (minutes).
- Storage/residency: EU and NA residency required for region-specific customers.
- Audit & security: SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 12 months, KMS integration required.

POC scope discussed:
- 2-week POC on Redwood Dedicated: run against subset (2M docs) and synthetic traffic to validate p95 & cost.
- Evaluate two reranker models: cross-encoder (high quality) vs lightweight interaction model to trade quality/latency.
- Measure three axes: latency (p50/p95/p99), cost/query, top-5 quality (annotated eval set ~5k queries).

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-22: Intro call (AE Maya) — product fit + business case (internal doc deflection target: 30% fewer human touches).
- 2026-02-04: SE workshop (Arjun) — architecture review; decided hybrid retrieval + rerank approach. Action: provide sample eval set.
- 2026-02-25: Security sync (Lucia + security team) — asked for KMS and audit log details; legal to start residency review.
- 2026-03-02: Kickoff POC scoping meeting (Fireflies ff_20260302_01): agreed metrics and POC timeline.
- 2026-03-06: Reranker demo (ff_20260306_rerank-demo). Customer requested top-5 exportable ranking for manual QA.
- 2026-03-08: Cost model review — they requested modeled cost per query at 20k qps-month to estimate ARR impact.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need the first answer to be trustworthy — if the model suggests a KB article, it must be correct 90%+ in top-1 for self-serve."
- "If reranking kills latency we lose SLA; so explore cached prefix or candidate-limited rerank."

Technical concerns flagged by customer:
- Reranker scaling: cross-encoder at top-100 is too expensive; want top-10 or learned sparse hybrid.
- Cold-start for attachments (OCR + embeddings) — ingest pipeline must handle heavy preprocessing.
- Region routing: EU customers must never leave EU; need routing/fallback policy documented.

Next steps (short):
- Send POC statement of work + data ingestion checklist by 2026-03-12 (AE).
- SE to prepare annotated eval set and baseline metrics (Arjun) by 2026-03-15.
- Security to provide KMS integration diagram and SOC2 docs (Lucia) — blocker for procurement.
- Schedule Dedicated POC kickoff for 2026-03-18 (target).

POC success criteria (customer-defined):
- End-to-end p95 <= 300ms for rerank-enabled deflection calls at 20 qps.
- Top-5 precision >= baseline + 18% on 5k eval queries.
- Modeled cost per query <= $0.02 at 20k qpm month equivalent.
- Clear plan for EU residency and KMS/GDPR compliance.

Other notes:
- Suggested Redwood features that matter to them: automatic KV/prefix caching, model variant fallback (smaller reranker when under load), batch-aware routing, and cost/perf Optimize recommendations.
- Preferred comms: AE + SE + security weekly syncs, add product manager for production roll-out planning after successful POC.
